verdict.rationale: Gmail ships a documented public RESTful API: a reference covering threads, messages and labels, explicit endpoints such as POST users.messages.send and drafts.send, push notifications for mailbox changes, and documented OAuth scopes. Developers can therefore drive the product programmatically. Community developers corroborate the API as a replacement for hacky IMAP code. missing for 10: probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the developers.google.com paths, and there is no independent hands-on report of an agent driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A API Gmail é uma API RESTful que permite acessar caixas de e-mail do Gmail e enviar e-mails.
L'API Gmail ti consente di visualizzare e gestire i dati della casella di posta Gmail, come thread, messaggi ed etichette.
The Gmail API provides server push notifications that let you watch for changes to Gmail mailboxes.
You can send it from a draft, using the drafts.send method.
